description: Entry records a decoder rejects under rowKey, with the reason code each is rejected for (journals.md §7): each breaks one rule, but the cases which name a rule checked first, which break two and are rejected for the earlier rule in §7's order; every record long enough to hold one carries the CRC-32C of its row key and bytes, but the crc-mismatch cases.

cases.name: No bytes.
Five bytes: a CRC-32C and a kind, without the base's length.
A payload byte flipped after the CRC-32C was computed.
A valid record of the journal "orders/42", verified under the row key of the journal "orders/43".
Kind 4 under the CRC-32C of kind 0: the CRC-32C is checked before the kind.
Kind 4.
Kind 255 with a base length of 40: the kind is checked before the version.
A base of 33 bytes.
A base length of 255 with the record ending after it: the length is checked before the base's bytes.
A base of 4 bytes of which the record holds 2.
A record which ends after its base, with no count.
An overlong count: 0 in two bytes.
A count of 11 bytes.
A count whose 10th byte passes the u64.
An unterminated count.
An Append whose overlong count ends the record: the count is checked before the body.
A Delete whose overlong count precedes a negative deletion time: the count is checked first.
A Delete with 7 bytes of deletion time.
A Delete stamped at tick -1.
A Delete stamped one tick after the last of 9999.
A Delete stamped at tick -1 with a byte after it: the deletion time is checked before the body.
An Append with an empty body.
A Delete with a byte after its deletion time.
An Expired with a byte after its expected version.
